Large residual insulation does not establish a manufacturing design or current rating. Saved mechanical winding angular datum 0 degrees; unchanged native optical orientation 0 rad. The primary six-coil datum defines its previously uncalibrated CAD/electrical phase; it is shared by winding and passive cartridge CAD and does not edit an optical drive, installation-error input or clipping boundary. Existing optical controls and transport boundaries remain authoritative. Auxiliary winding CAD adds no opaque cartridge. Final engineering pack-clearance refinement: co-located Image QPol uses radial fractions 0.34..0.47 and Image HPol uses 0.53..0.66 of their unchanged annular envelope. The complete QPol pack corner radius lies below the HPol minimum radius. New initial count is 63 per coil from the same 0.02 mm2 metal, 0.005 mm enamel and nominal 60% fill estimator. The prior 156 was an unreleased authoring stage, not a pre-task physical count. No old measured/adopted count, bore, outer envelope, axial bound or optical working-point value is changed. Refit current explicitly.
